last_episode_to_air.overview:
TZE-WAH's leg has to be cut off. YEE-LING is by his died to comfort

him. Their affection grows.

YUET-YUE decides to leave Hong Kong for the States. MAN-YING also

plans to go back to Canada. WAI-KIT is saddened.

WAI-KIT sets KWAN-CHEK up and finally arrests him. At this point,

MAN-WAI suddenly appears and stabs KWAN-CHEK. KWAN-CHEK is rushed to

the hospital while MAN-WAI is sent to the psychiatric hospital.

CHEUK agrees to stand as witness in the prosecution against KWAN-

CHEK. His son KWAN-HAN returns to Hong Kong. But he refuses to

reconcile with CHEUK. CHEUK ides of heart attack in the prison.

WAI-KIT ponders if he should ask MAN-YING to stay. Would there be a

happy ending between the two? What is the end of KWAN-CHEK? The

answers are in the final episode.

name: Police Cadet
overview:
Police Cadet '84 was a TV series which included such stars in TVB as Tony Leung, Maggie Cheung, and notably, Carina Lau. The story centered on a couple of young "cadets" in the Police Cadet School. Tragedy, romance, conflicts, and intrigues were featured.

The series was immediately followed by a sequels titled "New Police Cadet '85" and "New Police Cadet '88". Both sequels stars Tony Leung.
